articles.title: nearly 1,000 wooden chimes turn le bruit du bois into an alpine instrument
articles.summary: A unique timber pavilion, 'le bruit du bois', has been constructed high in the French Alps near Faverges-Seythenex. This long wooden structure is designed not merely as static architecture, but as an interactive space intended to encourage play and engagement within its natural alpine setting. Its innovative design blends art and public space, offering a distinct example of contemporary international architecture.

articles.title: Lanterns showrunner says they didn't want to "make a big deal" about the DCU show's Batman mention in episode 6: "There were fewer conversations than you'd think"
articles.summary: Lanterns showrunner Chris Mundy revealed that incorporating a nod to the DCU's Batman into episode 6 was surprisingly easy. Mundy told GamesRadar there were "shockingly fewer conversations than you would think," indicating a smooth creative process. This suggests straightforward collaboration for integrating iconic DC characters, underscoring the ease with which cross-universe references can be made within the expanding DC cinematic and television landscape.
